children: JPMorgan closed public offerings of $6.999 billion aggregate principal amount of notes across three series.
Closed offerings of $350M floating-rate notes due 2030, $2.9B fixed-to-floating notes due 2030, and $3.75B fixed-to-floating notes due 2037.
Offerings were registered on Form S-3 (File No. 333-285537), ensuring compliance with Securities Act registration requirements.
Legal opinion on the legality of the notes is filed as Exhibit 5.1 to the 8-K, supporting the issuance.
